items.name: FMC for Cancer Reigate 2026
items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**Proceeds from this competition will be donated to [Cancer Research UK](https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/), which funds research into treatments for cancer which will affect 1 in 3 people. Your participation in this competition could be saving lives!**

items.name: Fast in Fargo 2026

venue.name: Fargo Parks Sports Center at the Sanford Sports Complex

items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and and [Visit Fargo-Moorhead](https://www.fargomoorhead.org/). 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d783e6bc8ef9637fd7108a6fcfdc60829bd500da/image.png) 


We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: Cube Against Cancer Franklin 2026
items.information:
**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67811-cube-against-cancercubeassociation.org) tab for more information.**

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67812-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
